rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early-stage mass in all four views, with a single dominant compact volume and a carved/indented edge that aligns with the verified frontage access. The non-rectangular footprint gives it some site response rather than a dead box, and the roof/profile has enough variation to avoid being purely generic. The main weakness is that the public void is still modest and reads more as a notch than a strongly inhabitable court, so void_publicness is only moderate. Program fit is acceptable for neighborhood living because the mass suggests a street building with an active threshold and a calm upper body, but it is not yet as explicit as the best references in expressing shared public space or terraced communal sequence. No view reveals colliding solids or contradictory geometry across views, and the form remains repairable rather than over-clipped.
